attempt: Return through the burning house and reach Moss.
interference: The fire has already reached the wool rug and shared room while Moss is unseen.
change: He drops valuable portal materials, sends water towards the room and breaks in before the film cuts.
purpose: Open with loss, action and an honestly withheld outcome.
reveal: The protagonist values Moss above the house and has returned carrying crying obsidian and glowstone.
visual: Purple materials hit the ground as water crosses the burning rug.
audio: Fire and block breaking overtake one short narration line.

attempt: Survey a new clearing and decide whether it can become home.
interference: The ravine is remote, but water, timber and shelter make it promising.
change: Moss sits at the overlook, the protagonist records the place and decides they can stay.
purpose: Establish the relationship, blank journal and surface image later reinterpreted by the ending.
reveal: The pair arrive together and the ravine symbol belongs to the protagonist's ordinary notation.
visual: Morning wide shot, Moss at the ledge and a clean journal page.
audio: The repeated line about Moss's vote plays over quiet ambience.

attempt: Identify the portal hum and test the impossible frame.
interference: The crying-obsidian frame is complete and active despite no local path, mine or builder evidence.
change: Observation cannot explain it, so he leads Moss through.
purpose: Honour the portal promise through accountable curiosity.
reveal: The private unvisited ravine contains a portal that cannot be an ordinary Nether frame.
visual: Hand, wolf and purple plane share the threshold before the transition.
audio: Portal hum replaces narration at the decision.

attempt: Orient in the Rain Echo and return to R0.
interference: The same stone profile exists beneath incompatible water, weather and vegetation.
change: He explores, confirms the coordinates and re-enters the portal, only to emerge in the Ash Echo.
purpose: Deliver the requested confusion, exploration and failed return.
reveal: A crying portal is not reversible through immediate re-entry.
visual: The granite seam matches while a waterfall and scorched horizon replace the clearing.
audio: Rain cuts abruptly to dry wind after the second transition.

attempt: Test whether the destination is another reality or a changing version of one world.
interference: The frame persists, but local details contradict the previous echo.
change: He places a cobblestone mark beside the mouth, records it and finds it absent after the next crossing.
purpose: Turn disorientation into an audience-readable experiment.
reveal: Adjacent matter stays with its reality while matching coordinates and frame geometry recur.
visual: A clean matched close-up replaces the marked portal foot.
audio: Pick-up and placement sounds create the comparison without explanatory dialogue.

attempt: Search the Archive Echo for food, shelter and portal evidence.
interference: An abandoned survey recess contains a damaged book that looks like his own journal.
change: Matching symbols and diagrams identify the Weeping Atlas and the one-way next-arrow rule.
purpose: Establish the invented crying-frame mechanism through personal evidence.
reveal: A full frame plus direct anchor discharge may reach the traveller's first threshold, but the safety measurement is missing.
visual: Clean journal and weathered Atlas lie open on matching ravine symbols.
audio: Page turns, distant portal instability and sparse narration carry the discovery.

attempt: Reach a habitable echo before the Archive mouth fails.
interference: The portal plane flickers and the surrounding reality offers no safe long-term shelter.
change: He crosses with Moss, reaches R4 and cannot relight the extinguished local mouth.
purpose: End uncontrolled travel and force life in one reality.
reveal: The Atlas describes a possible return, but he lacks a frame, anchor and materials.
visual: Purple light collapses to an inert crying outline as flint produces no response.
audio: Portal sound drains into ordinary ravine ambience.

attempt: Turn the R4 shelter into a shared home beside the only known seam.
interference: The compact footprint demands a fireplace near the main room, and Moss repeatedly chooses the warm floor beside it.
change: He surrounds the flame with stone but places a wool rug inside its potential spread range.
purpose: Make the home, Moss routine and fire cause one continuous visual choice.
reveal: The cold-open house and rug arise from care rather than decorative coincidence.
visual: Moss settles on fresh wool while the stone hearth burns behind it.
audio: Building rhythm, feeding and domestic fire replace heavy narration.

attempt: Prepare the first-threshold method without risking an incomplete activation.
interference: A full crying frame and charged anchor require more materials than he has.
change: He gathers gradually, studies the torn blast page and plans one final supply run.
purpose: Give the final inventory an ordinary origin and contrast patience with later haste.
reveal: He understands that activation is dangerous before Moss disappears.
visual: Crying blocks, glowstone slots and a rough stone-baffle sketch accumulate beside the Atlas.
audio: Measured inventory sounds support restrained explanation.

attempt: Collect the remaining crying obsidian and glowstone without exposing Moss to the dangerous route.
interference: The open hearth is left burning and Moss's familiar safe command position is the wool rug.
change: He seats Moss, leaves through the conventional supply route and returns carrying the final materials.
purpose: Join the portal plan, absence and fire setup through one responsible-looking decision.
reveal: The exact conditions of the cold open are now in place.
visual: The door closes on Moss beside the hearth; the shot holds after the protagonist leaves.
audio: Footsteps fade until only the fire remains.

attempt: Reach Moss immediately after seeing smoke on the return ridge.
interference: Fire has spread from the rug into timber and obscured the shared room.
change: He completes the cold-open route, reaches the sitting place and finds it empty.
purpose: Resolve the opening action without creating a property-versus-life choice.
reveal: Moss is gone in R4, though no body or death message establishes the exact fate.
visual: The camera continues past the earlier cut to the consumed rug position.
audio: Narration falls silent through the search of the room.

attempt: Search beyond the house and decide what the remaining evidence allows.
interference: There is no response nearby, while the burn fan leads back to the rug and the Atlas promises only a dangerous route.
change: He retrieves the dropped materials and carries the Atlas into the ravine.
purpose: Let grief become a consequential decision after a credible search.
reveal: The final supply run caused his absence, but it also completed the inventory needed to reach the first threshold.
visual: Empty paths give way to crying blocks stacked at the dead mouth.
audio: Sparse narration states belief rather than certainty about Moss.

attempt: Build the exact full crying frame and a survivable activation position.
interference: The Atlas requires direct discharge and its final blast-distance measurement is torn away.
change: He completes the frame, charges the anchor and accepts an incomplete stone baffle.
purpose: Pay off builder identity, materials and the knowledge source before the climax.
reveal: The portal nobody made in R0 is materially constructed by the protagonist in R4.
visual: Opening portal close-ups recur as each crying block takes its coordinate.
audio: Placement sounds echo the initial inspection in reverse order.

attempt: Wake the frame and cross to the first threshold.
interference: Direct interaction keeps him inside the unverified blast problem.
change: The anchor explodes and kills him; after the debris settles, the invented portal field lights.
purpose: Resolve the final choice through mechanism rather than exposition.
reveal: The activation succeeds after its intended traveller is dead.
visual: White blast, still frame, then purple light through smoke.
audio: The explosion cuts all sound before the portal hum slowly returns.

attempt: In the revealed R0 moment, choose whether the clearing should become home.
interference: Neither the earlier protagonist nor Moss knows the active receiving mouth waits beneath them.
change: The camera rises into the repeated arrival, the blank journal opens and the decision to stay leads towards discovery.
purpose: Close the spatial, journal and emotional loop in one visual transformation.
reveal: The final portal reaches the Return to the beginning reality and precedes its own discovery.
visual: Stone becomes soil, then the exact morning wide shot of Moss at the overlook.
audio: The opening line repeats as a faint portal hum enters below it.
